label: Household elder

faceRig.convention: Local +X points to the character's left: +X pitch looks down / closes the upper lid / opens the lower lid / opens the jaw; +Z yaws the eyes toward the character's right. Same frames in Blender and in the exported glTF.

lodCalibration.method: scripts/characters/lib/face_rig.py: LOD1/Quest head lid and jaw weights authored from the eye and mouth loops; upperLidClosed found by bisection so the closed lids overlap 0.6 mm everywhere with the lower lid at lowerLidClosed; jawOpen parts the lips lipGapMm.full at full opening. Radians. Since round 2 the LOD1 and Quest levels also carry the face morphs, so the shared adapters blink and speak by morph there and these joint angles drive only the face clips and joints-only consumers.

sockets.socket_hand_l_spoon: prop_spoon (attach to joint hand_l, keep the local transform)
sockets.socket_hand_l_stick: prop_stick (attach to joint hand_l, keep the local transform)
sockets.socket_hand_r_knife: prop_knife (attach to joint hand_r, keep the local transform)
sockets.socket_hips_knife_rest: prop_knife_rest (attach to joint hips_knife, keep the local transform)
sockets.socket_hips_spoon_rest: prop_spoon_rest (attach to joint hips_spoon, keep the local transform)

props.workplace: node 'workplace' (already Y-up) holds workplace_static relative to the resident root in the work pose

stick.rule: tip 19 cm outside the left ankle; lands 24 cm ahead of the right heel as the right heel strikes, comes down vertically and lifts straight up before the shaft can reach the cloak (liftAtYBlender); the fist 2 cm below the top; the hand stays in front of the cloak's opening

props-quest.note: Quest props atlas; with the household at work each set adds one draw per hand prop plus one for its static workplace

envelopes.note: glTF model frame (Y up, +Z forward), metres. Every body clip skinned at every frame from Blender's own pose evaluation (scripts/characters/lib/envelopes.py), face-morph vertices padded by the sum of their 16 largest deltas, widened by half the largest per-frame vertex travel plus 5 mm. Pass envelopes[level][clip] to the owner (patch 5), which checks each at 9 times.

penetration.note: maxThroughMm is capped at backReach + margin; hand pairs (gloves, mitts and skin weighted to the hands) are listed under handClips because a swinging hand meets a skirt from beside, not from under it; inner shell faces (normal facing the body) are not paired

posedHands.note: per frame, each hand's skin and mitt or glove vertices are tested against the posed outer garments (Cloak, HoodCape): a vertex is inside a garment when a horizontal ray from the body axis through it meets the garment beyond it; a hand with at least 3 vertices on each side crosses the cloth (it comes out through it). Counts are the vertices on the minority side.

heldStick.note: round 2: the held stick (prop_stick in hand_l through its grip) sampled every centimetre along the shaft; a point is inside cloth when a horizontal ray from the body axis through it meets a garment beyond it. Fails when any sampled frame has more than limitMetres of shaft inside cloth.

textureMemoryNote: decodedTextureBytesEstimate assumes RGBA8 with full mips; not a GPU measurement.
